about.en: TEA is the token of the tea Protocol, a framework that rewards open-source software maintainers and contributors according to the measured impact of their packages, using a Proof of Contribution ranking across the open-source ecosystem. It is staked to support and vouch for projects and pays out contribution rewards. TEA is the ERC-20 token at 0x7eA7ea50ed58BC4d0a9194bCD328E21F7Be80c2B on Ethereum.
